sections.note: flattened single leaf node, no child structure captured
primary page purpose is a scheduling widget (e.g. Calendly) whose iframe DOM is invisible to the capture tool

proposed_rules.trigger: A page's main content area is a single flattened text leaf (heading+intro merged, no child structure) despite the page clearly hosting an interactive third-party embed (scheduling widget, chat, form).
proposed_rules.decision: Map the flattened leaf as default-content (heading + intro paragraph) and flag the embed itself as a distinct block (e.g. 'scheduler-embed') requiring Phase 2 manual identification of the embed provider/src, rather than assuming the page has no further content.
proposed_rules.rationale: Cross-origin iframes (Calendly-style schedulers, chat widgets, forms) render opaque to DOM-walking capture tools; the visual tree collapses everything into one leaf. Without flagging, the primary CTA/purpose of a 'Meet with Sales' page would be silently dropped from the EDS block inventory.

provenance.evidence: C176 rc1c2 single flattened 1280x1211 leaf with no children, text 'Meet With Sales Need help? Sch...'

notes: Very small contact/sales page whose actual embedded scheduler is not visible in the DOM-walk; flagged for Phase 2 targeted extraction rather than treated as an empty page.
